_about: The number of admitted coverage gaps may only go down. Lower this number whenever a gap is closed; raising it means the site grew without a check, and the commit that does so must say why. 2026-10-09: set to the real count (78) when server/src/e2e-gate.test.ts began enforcing it — before that the 0 was an aspiration nothing checked. Gaps by area that day: ops 25, audience 16, jobs 11, editorial 9, ships 6, commentary 6, news 3, affiliate 1, flows 1.
